change: A sender can write only when it has calls to send: with CALL_LOG_DEADLINE_SECONDS (StorageSink's deadline_seconds; in JS deadlineSeconds and flushDue(); the call-log object's vars), each dataset's file goes once its first unsent call has waited the deadline, and no report goes alone, the counters riding in the next call file; with CALL_LOG_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS too, a quiet dataset also writes its report alone each heartbeat (a heartbeat alone has a deadline of two minutes); with neither set, a file every two minutes as before
